materials.onBeforeCompile:
(i) => {
        (i.uniforms.uRain = iy),
          (i.vertexShader = i.vertexShader
            .replace(
              "#include <common>",
              `#include <common>
attribute vec4 aSurf; varying vec3 vObjP; varying vec3 vWNrm; varying vec3 vONrm; varying vec4 vSurf;`,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <begin_vertex>",
              `#include <begin_vertex>
vObjP = position; vONrm = normal; vWNrm = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal); vSurf = aSurf;`,
            )),
          (i.fragmentShader = i.fragmentShader
            .replace(
              "#include <common>",
              `#include <common>
#define D_KIND ` +
                (e | 0) +
                `
` +
                Hz,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <metalnessmap_fragment>",
              `#include <metalnessmap_fragment>
` + Oz,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <normal_fragment_maps>",
              `#include <normal_fragment_maps>
` + Vz,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <aomap_fragment>",
              `#include <aomap_fragment>
` + Wz,
            ));
      }

materials.name: apron_wet
materials.onBeforeCompile:
(r) => {
        Object.assign(r.uniforms, t),
          (r.vertexShader =
            `varying vec3 vGWorld;
` +
            r.vertexShader.replace(
              "#include <begin_vertex>",
              `#include <begin_vertex>
  vGWorld = (modelMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;`,
            )),
          (r.fragmentShader = r.fragmentShader
            .replace(
              "#include <common>",
              `#include <common>
` + TP,
            )
            .replace("#include <map_fragment>", AP)
            .replace(
              "#include <roughnessmap_fragment>",
              "float roughnessFactor = gRough;",
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <normal_fragment_maps>",
              `#include <normal_fragment_maps>
  normal = normalize(mat3(viewMatrix) * normalize(vec3(-gNxz.x, 1.0, -gNxz.y)));`,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <lights_physical_fragment>",
              `#include <lights_physical_fragment>
  material.specularColor = mix(material.specularColor, vec3(0.075), max(gPuddle, gSoak * 0.5));`,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <lights_fragment_maps>",
              `#include <lights_fragment_maps>
` + RP,
            )
            .replace(
              "#include <lights_fragment_end>",
              `#include <lights_fragment_end>
  reflectedLight.directSpecular = min(reflectedLight.directSpecular, vec3(40.0));`,
            ));
      }
